J&J’s innovative medicines carried Q3 as medtech disappoints, but newer medicines absent
snippet: While innovative medicine supported Johnson & Johnson’s “in line” earnings for the third quarter of 2026, investors were disappointed to see older medicines carrying the bag.

title: BioNTech faces 3rd mRNA setback as head and neck cancer therapy fails to improve survival
snippet: While BNT113 failed to improve progression-free survival in patients with a type of head and neck cancer during a Phase 3 trial, BioNTech is holding out hope for an overall survival win—but analysts say that outcome is now "less likely."

title: Roche expands obesity R&D footprint with Rona deal worth $1B+
snippet: Roche has gained access to a genetic obesity approach from China's Rona Therapeutics for up to $100 million in upfront and near-term payments.

title: Syndax ends fibrosis program for Niktimvo after mid-stage disappointment
snippet: Syndax Pharmaceuticals will no longer test Niktimvo for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, but the company’s work to expand the drug’s label in chronic graft-versus-host disease, for which it was approved in 2024, will continue.

title: Pfizer pens $500M+ deal with Enodia to destroy disease-causing proteins
snippet: After Pfizer’s venture arm co-led Enodia Therapeutics’ $25 million seed round in January, the pharma has signed up to collaborate with the biotech on small-molecule drugs to eliminate pathogenic proteins where they’re being made.

title: Analysts eye RevMed’s pancreatic cancer launch, Merck’s data blitz for Q3 earnings
snippet: Bellwether Johnson & Johnson will kick off the third quarter earnings reporting period on Tuesday, with analysts searching for news on business development, launch execution and more.

title: BMS’ Phase 3 win for lung drug clouded by high-dose miss
snippet: A low-dose win could derisk a regulatory pathway for BMS’ LPA1 antagonist in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis after a recently reported patient death, but a miss at the higher dose leaves analysts awaiting full data.

title: RevMed's Rasonque gets a subtype data asterisk, but analysts remain bullish
snippet: Data released by the FDA show that Revolution Medicine’s newly approved pancreatic cancer drug underperformed in a large subgroup of patients, but analysts say the biotech still has a clear winner.

title: BMS’ $4.1B RayzeBio bet delivers Phase 3 radiopharma win
snippet: The centerpiece of Bristol Myers Squibb’s 2024 RayzeBio buy has read out, hitting the primary endpoint in a late-stage tumor trial.

title: GSK pledges $800M to add biologics production capabilities in Pennsylvania
snippet: Starting next year, GSK plans to demolish existing buildings and construct new facilities to support clinical and commercial supply. The investment will create more than 300 new jobs over the next five years, Pennsylvania state officials said.

title: How to boost throughput and data quality for stability testing of biologics
snippet: John Stenson from Malvern Panalytical explains why integrating multiple stability measurements onto a single platform is the route to success in early-stage biologics testing.

title: Caribou layoffs could wipe out 90% of staff
snippet: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

title: TRexBio, Retension raise $161.7M in IPOs; City, Iambic set proposed offering terms

title: Viatris inks $1.65B Pacira buyout to build non-opioid pain therapy business
snippet: With an internal non-opioid program nearing approval, Viatris is picking up Pacira BioSciences for a broader pain portfolio and the associated commercial infrastructure.

title: How Abogen went from COVID hype to a $7.8B Novartis deal
snippet: After Abogen Biosciences’ COVID shot missed the commercial window, the big question was whether its mRNA technology could create value beyond vaccines. Novartis’ $575 million upfront commitment is the clearest external validation yet of that broader therapeutic potential.

title: Eli Lilly and the LA Dodgers: A tale of 2 dynasties

title: Reusing data could cut R&D costs and greatly increase gene editing’s reach: ARM

title: Merck barred from making subcutaneous Keytruda in 8 European countries
